integrity: Finite extrema checked by independent exact-rational solvers and a complete graph enumeration; literature comparisons identify limited inspection and residual priority risk.
limitations: Only connected simple graphs on 2–4 vertices under strict two-phase alternation and graph-specific lazy Metropolis transition rule are classified; no larger-order claims, global mixing inference, or independent priority adjudication.
title: Sharp four-state hitting-time slowdown under alternating lazy Metropolis walks
